title: Happily Ever After 3 Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Happily Ever After 3 is a 3 BR / 2.5 BA / 9 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. The kitchen is straight out of a magazine with its beautiful colors, open cabinets, and chef's appliances.
description_expanded: Description56 TUPELO STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 2 FULL, 1 DAYBED - Sleeps 9Prime Seaside Location Near the Beach & Town CenterCompletely remodeled in 2016 and thoughtfully renovated again in 2023, this beautifully updated three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath vacation home offers relaxed coastal style and comfortable accommodations for up to nine guests. Ideally located in Seaside, Florida, the home sits just six houses from the beach and three blocks from downtown Seaside, placing Airstream Row, Modica Market, and more than 35 shops and restaurants within an easy stroll from your front door.Welcoming Outdoor Living & Front Porch CharmGuests are welcomed by convenient parking directly in front of the home and an inviting open-air front porch. Designed for easy coastal living, the porch features a sectional sofa and two rocking chairs, creating the perfect setting for morning coffee, afternoon lounging, or gathering with family after a beach day.Spacious Living Areas & Open-Concept DesignInside, fresh renovations and designer furnishings set a bright and comfortable tone throughout the home. The entry opens to two distinct living areas—one arranged with four club chairs for conversation and the other featuring a sofa, two club chairs, and a large mounted flat-screen TV, ideal for movie nights or relaxing evenings in. A newly added dining area anchors the main floor with a generous table that seats up to twelve, surrounded by windows that fill the space with natural light.Updated Kitchen & Entertaining EssentialsThe renovated kitchen is fully equipped for family meals and entertaining, offering breakfast bar seating for three, stainless steel appliances, a large double-door refrigerator with freezer drawer, dishwasher, and custom built-in shelving. A conveniently located half bath on the first floor adds ease for guests and gatherings.Comfortable Bedrooms & Modern BathroomsThe first-floor king primary suite provides a private retreat with a mounted flat-screen TV and an ensuite bathroom featuring a marble single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms share a full hall bath. One bedroom offers a queen bed, bay window seating, and a small closet, while the second bedroom is ideal for kids or groups with two full beds and a day bed, comfortably sleeping five. This room also includes a large mounted flat-screen TV for entertainment. The shared hall bath features a single vanity and a glass-enclosed tub and shower combination.The washer and dryer for this cottage are located off the exterior porch. (washer and dryer may be shared with the rear unit Happily Tower if rented) This home also has a two-bedroom guest cottage Happily Ever Tower that can be rented, or the main home and guest home together as Happily Ever After a five-bedroom home sleeping 13 in total. 5-night minimum Spring & Spring Break; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Only Happily Ever After 5 bedroom home available during summer. FEATURESSeaside Private Residential Beach at Tupelo Pavilion308 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach accessWasher and dryer available (may be shared with rear guest cottage, Happily Tower)Peacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts, and a fitness center (court fees apply)Welcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityBeach towels providedPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit. No pets allowed
